_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation Paper. Proposes VIPAC (Visible Light Integrated Positioning and Communication) using Multi-Task Learning (MTL) and Federated Learning (FL). Jointly performs VLP and VLC Channel Estimation.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: System model (MTL network structure). Fig 2: MTL architecture (Shared network + Sub-networks). Fig 5-9: Simulation results (NMSE, Positioning Error CDF).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Indoor VLC ISAC. Waveform: OFDM with pilots. Method: Deep Learning (MTL for feature sharing, FL for distributed training). Tasks: Channel Estimation (Comm) + Positioning (Sensing).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm (Channel Est): NMSE ~10^-3 (superior to OMP/LS). Positioning: RMSE ~6.7 cm at 35 dB SNR. Generalization: FL improves robustness to environmental changes.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Advanced AI/ML application in O-ISAC. Addresses privacy (FL) and resource efficiency (MTL). Focuses on algorithmic improvement rather than new optical hardware.

bibliographic.title: Visible Light Integrated Positioning and Communication: A Multi-Task Federated Learning Framework
bibliographic.authors: Tiankuo Wei, Sicong Liu, Xiaojiang Du

application.scenario_description: Indoor VLC network providing simultaneous illumination, communication, and centimeter-level positioning.

key_contribution.key_contribution: MTL-based network for joint VLP/CE and Federated Learning framework for privacy/generalization.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Isolated design of VLP/VLC and poor generalization in non-stationary environments.

transmitter.notes: 4 LEDs per cluster. OFDM (N=1024, CP=64). 20 MHz bandwidth.

receiver.notes: PD receiving signals from multiple LEDs.

integration.notes: Pilots shared for positioning and CE.

waveform.notes: Pilots embedded in OFDM frame used for both tasks.

sensing_metrics.notes: Positioning Error ~6.7 cm at 35dB SNR. 90% CDF < 10cm.
